feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 199 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: LLM Usage Log Analyzer — where your Claude and GPT API spend goes
entry.summary: Paste an LLM API usage log (JSONL, JSON or CSV) and see spend by model, feature and day, your cache hit rate, a 30-day run rate, and which levers -- caching, batch, a cheaper model -- would have saved money. Runs in your browser; the log never leaves it. Free, no signup.
